sources.title: Caribbean National Weekly, Haiti sets new passport fees for citizens applying abroad (7 October 2026)
sources.said: Haiti has set new fees for citizens applying for passports at Haitian diplomatic missions and consular posts abroad, while banning additional charges and expedited processing services. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Religious Affairs announced the new measures in a circular dated Oct. 1, with the changes taking effect Oct. 5. Under the new fee structure, passport applications will cost US$150 for adults and US$125 for minors. The ministry said any additional fees charged for passport applications are illegal and prohibited. It also ordered Haitian diplomatic missions and consular posts to stop offering emergency and extreme-emergency passport services.
